text:
incident-bot: Paging SRE oncall due to edge proxy request spike hitting embeddings and /v1/chat endpoints. alert: 8xx errors rising, token spend up 4x. Page sent to @Alex (on-call)
Alex (on-call): on it — looking at traffic now. what endpoints affected?
Mike B: embeddings heavily hit from a few ASN ranges, lots of short-lived IP churn and randomized UA strings. pattern looks like scraper farm with rotate+parallel.
Anjali R: seeing high prefix cache-miss rate and KV eviction spikes on the runtime. latency for small requests is up from 30ms -> 180ms on some pods.
Elaine T: customers complaining about increased 429s — a handful of enterprise keys hit quota abruptly. product ops flagged 3 active customers likely collateral.
Alex (on-call): starting live mitigations: 1) apply rate-slice on edge by src ASN and UA signature, 2) tighten WAF rule for common scraping patterns, 3) emergency quota bump for affected enterprise tokens to reduce noise. will coord with Mike/Anjali.
Mike B: proposed quick edge rule (nginx lua) to reject >5 req/s per IP with exponential backoff and allowlist known infra keys. sample:
```
if (reqs_from_ip > 5) then
  return 429
end
```
This is safe to deploy at edge for 10m.
Anjali R: enabling prefix-based KV caching for chat to avoid repeated full model execs from identical prefix bursts. applying canary to 2 regions first.
incident-bot: Deploy job started: edge-rate-slice-v1 -> canary -> 2 regions (iad, ewr). logs at https://ci.internal/deploy/edge-rate-slice-v1
Alex (on-call): WAF rule updated to block common scraping UA regex and repeated identical body signatures. rule id waf-312 applied in monitor mode for 5m then block.
Elaine T: Notifying affected customers now: "We are applying targeted rate controls to mitigate abusive traffic; you may see transient 429s — we are issuing temporary quota relief where necessary." sending email and dashboard banner.
Product Ops: note for postmortem — capture list of affected API keys + customer contacts and compensation decision if >1hr impact.
Mike B: monitoring metrics: token rate falling ~60% after edge rule, 5xxs down. small % of legitimate traffic hitting rule — added allowlist for 3 known SDK CI IP ranges.
Anjali R: observed reduction in KV eviction, latency trending back to baseline in canary regions. will expand to global in 15m if stable.
Alex (on-call): handing off to Elaine for customer comms and to Anjali for remediation rollout. I’m going offline for 30m to sleep. leaving runbook notes in thread.
Elaine T: ack. keeping watch on dashboards and will escalate to exec if customers report SLO breaches. drafting follow-up.
incident-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-0457. severity: high -> mitigated (monitoring). please update ticket with timeline and root cause hypothesis.
Alex (on-call): RCA hypothesis: distributed scraper farm using rapid IP churn + header variation to evade caching and WAF. long-term actions: add adaptive rate-slicing, expand signature coverage, improve customer-level surge protection and quota graceful degradation.
Mike B: action items: (1) permanent edge rate-slice rule w/ ASNs + UA familes (2) integrate anomaly detection to auto-throttle high-entropy request patterns (3) postmortem and shared dashboards.
Anjali R: I’ll schedule a follow-up deploy to enable conservative KV caching for chat+embeds and measure false-positive rate.
Elaine T: I’ll finish customer comms and propose a small credit for customers with >30m degraded experience.
Product Ops: leaving notes for finance and account teams. postmortem owner: Elaine. ETA draft: 48h.
Alex (on-call): thanks team — leaving thread. if anything regresses, ping @Alex and I’ll jump in. :thumbsup:
